Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zusbml 0.0.0.9000

  • sbml_read() reads SBML Level 3 Version 1 and 2 core documents from a file, a URL, XML text or a raw vector into an sbml_model, with one data frame per element kind (sbml_species(), sbml_reactions(), …). Malformed documents raise zusbml_parse_error naming the element path and attribute; SBML packages and other levels raise zusbml_unsupported, and ignore_packages = TRUE reads the core of a package document.

  • Model math is R language objects: <apply><power/> is ^, <piecewise> is nested if, lambdas are function expressions, and operators without a base R equivalent keep their SBML names (quotient(), rateOf(), …). sbml_math() shows math as R code, and sbml_functions() adds each function definition as a callable R function.

  • sbml_odes() derives the states, right-hand sides, assignments, constants and events of a model, following the Level 3 Version 2 specification, and sbml_initial_state() gives the states at time 0. Algebraic rules, the delay csymbol and fast reactions are refused with zusbml_unsupported; assignment cycles and missing values are zusbml_derive_error.

  • Events are derived and run: sbml_derivs() returns a derivative function for deSolve with the root function and event handler that apply SBML’s event semantics (delays, persistence, priorities, values from trigger time, events at time 0). All 1,384 supported SBML Test Suite cases reproduce their reference results.

  • sbml_to_rxode2() writes the equations of a model as rxode2 model text; events are refused, or left out with events = "drop".

  • sbml_write() writes a model as SBML Level 3 Version 2; reading it back gives an identical model for every readable SBML Test Suite case. sbml_write_json() writes the model object as JSON with zujson.

  • sbml_check() reports structural problems (duplicate ids, unresolved references, symbols set twice, rules or events on constants, assignment cycles) as a data frame.

  • zusbml_info() reports what the package reads and writes.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
